panels.alt: FE: Formal / executable. proved or exactly tested in the project model.
SC: Source-conditional. inherits only under the cited paper's assumptions.
CE: Conditional empirical. estimated in the declared finite design.
SI: Scoped implementation. checks one software or protocol boundary.
O: Open. not established by the current evidence.

Nesting grammar: arrows mean contains, pairs, or repeats. Use only the levels declared in each evidence row.
NT1: guarantees do not transfer between client, server, protocol, and application lanes

NT3: open external confirmation is not implied by formal or software evidence
